inspiration.observed_pattern: A MySQL report buckets dates with DATE_FORMAT, labels rollup NULLs through COALESCE, and aggregates by month, product, and channel with WITH ROLLUP.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as an independent monthly service-revenue report. It labels month, service, and route subtotals with COALESCE around DATE_FORMAT and grouped dimensions, then computes SUM totals through WITH ROLLUP; all schema, rows, labels, and business context are new.

fixture_notes: January and February each contain two services across two routes. The query must emit service-route details, service subtotals, monthly subtotals, and a grand total using explicit labels instead of NULL rollup markers.
determinism_notes: Fixed timestamps, service codes, route codes, amounts, label literals, derived aliases, and final ordering; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE service_revenue (revenue_id INT PRIMARY KEY, billed_at DATETIME NOT NULL, service_code VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, route_code VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, amount INT NOT NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT month_label, service_label, route_label, total_amount FROM (SELECT COALESCE(DATE_FORMAT(billed_at, '%Y-%m'), 'ALL MONTHS') AS month_label, COALESCE(service_code, 'ALL SERVICES') AS service_label, COALESCE(route_code, 'ALL ROUTES') AS route_label, SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM service_revenue GROUP BY COALESCE(DATE_FORMAT(billed_at, '%Y-%m'), 'ALL MONTHS'), service_code, route_code WITH ROLLUP) AS rollup_report ORDER BY month_label, service_label, route_label

checks.sql: SELECT month_label, service_label, route_label, total_amount FROM (SELECT COALESCE(DATE_FORMAT(billed_at, '%Y-%m'), 'ALL MONTHS') AS month_label, COALESCE(service_code, 'ALL SERVICES') AS service_label, COALESCE(route_code, 'ALL ROUTES') AS route_label, SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM service_revenue GROUP BY COALESCE(DATE_FORMAT(billed_at, '%Y-%m'), 'ALL MONTHS'), service_code, route_code WITH ROLLUP) AS rollup_report ORDER BY month_label, service_label, route_label
